description: Intake questions shown by the Responder app. A yes answer to a question with maps_to adds that symptom id to the encounter. Keypad: 1 = yes, 2 = no, 3 = don't know. Audio prompts: data/audio/<id>_<lang>.mp3 (placeholders until community recordings exist).
review: pending: Swahili wording needs native-speaker and clinician review

groups.en: Gave birth in the last 6 weeks

groups.sw: Baada ya mtoto kuzaliwa mfu au kupoteza mimba

questions.en: In your own words, what is the problem?
questions.sw: Kwa maneno yako, tatizo ni nini?

questions.en: Fever or feeling hot?
questions.sw: Homa au mwili kuwa na joto?

questions.en: For how many days?
Already took malaria tablets (mseto) for this fever?
questions.sw: Umeshameza dawa za malaria (mseto) kwa homa hii?

questions.en: Is the fever still there after the tablets?
questions.sw: Homa bado ipo baada ya dawa?

questions.en: Which medicines did you already buy or take?
Cough?
Cough for 2 weeks or more?
Fast or difficult breathing?
Diarrhoea?
Vomiting everything?
Rash on the body?
Any fits or convulsions?
How many weeks pregnant (or months x 4)?
questions.sw: Mimba ina wiki ngapi (au miezi x 4)?

questions.en: Any bleeding from the vagina?
Severe headache?
Blurred vision or seeing spots?
Swelling of face or hands?
Severe pain in the belly?
Is the baby moving less than usual?
questions.sw: Mtoto tumboni anacheza kidogo kuliko kawaida?

questions.en: How many clinic visits for this pregnancy so far?
questions.sw: Umehudhuria kliniki mara ngapi kwa mimba hii?

questions.en: Feeling very sad or hopeless most days?
questions.sw: Unajisikia huzuni sana au kukata tamaa siku nyingi?

questions.en: Have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
questions.sw: Umewahi kuwa na mawazo ya kujidhuru?

questions.en: How many days since the birth?
Heavy bleeding (soaking a pad in under an hour)?
questions.sw: Damu nyingi (pedi kujaa chini ya saa moja)?

questions.en: Bad-smelling discharge?
Severe headache?
Blurred vision?
Has your blood pressure been checked since the birth?
questions.sw: Shinikizo lako la damu limepimwa tangu ujifungue?

questions.en: Feeling very sad, crying, or no interest in things most days?
questions.sw: Unajisikia huzuni sana, kulia, au kukosa hamu ya mambo siku nyingi?

questions.en: Have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
questions.sw: Umewahi kuwa na mawazo ya kujidhuru?

questions.en: How is breastfeeding going?

modules.note: Ask gently. Offer condolences first. The responder can skip any question.

questions.en: Is there someone at home who can support you?
Would you like a health worker to follow up with you?
Child's age in months (years x 12)?
questions.sw: Umri wa mtoto kwa miezi (miaka x 12)?

questions.en: Not able to drink or breastfeed?
Very sleepy, weak, or hard to wake?
questions.sw: Amelegea, hana nguvu, au haamki vizuri?

questions.en: Vaccinations up to date (check the clinic card)?
Has your blood pressure ever been checked?
questions.sw: Shinikizo lako la damu limewahi kupimwa?

questions.en: Frequent headaches?
questions.sw: Maumivu ya kichwa mara kwa mara?

questions.en: Feeling very sad or hopeless most days?
questions.sw: Unajisikia huzuni sana au kukata tamaa siku nyingi?

questions.en: Have you had thoughts of harming yourself?
questions.sw: Umewahi kuwa na mawazo ya kujidhuru?

modules.note: Social determinants and exposures. Ask about the household, not only the patient.

questions.en: Does the family farm?
Animals at home (cows, goats, sheep), helping with animal births, or drinking unboiled milk?
questions.sw: Mifugo nyumbani (ng'ombe, mbuzi, kondoo), kusaidia wanyama kuzaa, au kunywa maziwa bila kuchemsha?

questions.en: Any animals sick or losing pregnancies recently?
questions.sw: Wanyama wowote wagonjwa au waliotupa mimba hivi karibuni?

questions.en: Rats at home, walking in flood or stream water, or muddy fields?
questions.sw: Panya nyumbani, kutembea kwenye maji ya mafuriko au mto, au mashamba ya matope?

questions.en: Main drinking water source?
questions.sw: Chanzo kikuu cha maji ya kunywa?

questions.en: How long to reach the nearest clinic?
questions.sw: Inachukua muda gani kufika kliniki iliyo karibu?

questions.en: How would you travel there?
Daily activity?
Which phone can you use?
Can you read SMS, or would you prefer a voice call?
questions.sw: Unaweza kusoma SMS, au ungependa simu ya sauti?

questions.en: Preferred language for messages?
Best time for a call (when the phone is with you)?
questions.sw: Muda mzuri wa kupigiwa simu (simu ikiwa nawe)?

questions.en: May we send your referral to the clinic and send you SMS or calls about it?
questions.sw: Tunaweza kutuma rufaa yako kliniki na kukutumia SMS au simu kuhusu hilo?

optional.sw: Kipimo cha shinikizo la damu (juu / chini)
